original_query: What substances are involved in the feeding of substrates?

confirmed.answer_text: The substances involved in feeding substrates include phenyl acetic acid or phenoxy acetic acid as a precursor, corn steep liquor (as a nitrogen source), soy meal, yeast extract, whey (as a carbon source), lactose, and various buffers.
cited_statements: Phenyl acetic acid or phenoxy acetic acid is fed continuously as a precursor
Corn steep liquor(4-5% dry weight), an additional nitrogen source i.e. soy meal, yeast extract, whey a carbon source such as lactose, and various buffers.
